text:
sam: Design — timeline check. Need a micro-interactive benchmark explainer (three microtiles with motion), a webinar motion opener (10s), and a landing hero SVG + static PNGs. Target internal webinar Tues 3/31. Can we get initial drafts by EOD Fri?

emily: Got it. Do we have specs: sizes, color tokens, priority locale, and any copy constraints?

sam: Audience = product + platform engineers and growth. Key message: 'Redwood cuts inference unit cost while keeping latency low' — exact numbers TBD. Asset list: Figma file + Lottie JSON for motion + PNG exports (1200x628, 600x600, 1600x900) and hero SVG. Accessibility: aim for WCAG AA contrast. :eyes:

javier: @sam for webinar flow we'll need a CTA banner that maps leads to /webinar?utm_campaign=redwood_inference_bench. Also need three lead magnets: benchmark one-pager, condensed prompt set, and 30s replay clip. Make filenames consistent for inbound mapping.

zoe: Heads up — brand requires updated logo lockups and restricted gradient use (no heavy illustrative gradients). Also legal wants a short data-source blurb with any benchmark claims: 'Based on internal tests run on N4 GPUs, Mar 2025' — include a subtle footnote area.

emily: Copy that. @sam — can you attach the benchmark CSV or mark numbers TBD? If TBD, I'll design placeholder states. @maya (Design Ops) any constraints on motion exports?

maya (Design Ops): Motion budget: 3 small motions (<=10s each) + 1 hero opener allowed. Delivery package: lottie JSON, mp4 fallback, and exported sprite PNGs. Export guidelines live in /design/exports — follow naming: project_asset_size_variant.ext.

emily: Proposed timeline — initial comps (Fri EOD), round 1 feedback (Mon), final assets (Tue AM). Microtile layout idea: 3 cards with a sparkline, headline delta, and 1-line caption. Using tokens: redwood-primary, redwood-muted, accent-amber. Will post Figma link when created. :white_check_mark:

sam: For the benchmark story we prefer absolute numbers + % delta callout. Sample CSV to mock with:```
model,sequence,latency_ms,cost_per_1k_tokens_usd
redwood-v1,128,45,0.023
openxyz-7b,128,78,0.055
```

emily: Nice sample — I'll mock those. @zoe please review brand variant before I finalize. @javier can you confirm lead routing fields (utm_source, utm_medium, campaign, gclid, plus hidden fields model_interest, batch_size)?

javier: Confirmed — we'll include utm_source, utm_medium, campaign and add hidden fields model_interest + batch_size. I'll map to HubSpot properties and set up auto-tagging.

zoe: I'll review by Sat AM. Note legal approval may add ~24h if we use precise numbers in claim lines.

sam: :thumbsup: Thanks. Emily — drop the Figma file in #marketing-assets and ping me when initial frames are up.

figma-bot: New file created: 'bench-explainer-figma' — https://figma.com/file/xxxxx (permissions set to company view).

emily: Uploaded first frames: https://figma.com/file/xxxxx/frame. Quick note: used placeholder numbers for 'openxyz-7b' until official CSV attached. Will swap once Sam confirms final CSV.

sam: I'll attach final CSV by Fri AM or mark officially TBD if delayed. Thanks team — will loop legal if numbers land early. :party_parrot:
